name: centraid-recognition-runtime
description: Deliberately NOT a Bun workspace package (issue #724 W8). The parent tools/recognition-automations directory is a workspace package so oxlint/typecheck/vitest/knip gates apply to its recognition-handler build source, while this nested runtime directory holds optional native ML/media dependencies and local model assets. `bun run --cwd tools/recognition-automations setup` installs here and downloads model weights next to the dependencies. Bundled handlers resolve them lazily, so root dependency resolution never installs native packages for code that does not use recognition.
